verdict.rationale: Smithery is an MCP registry and connection platform. A SaaS platform like this could plausibly ship a built-in assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence covers a REST connection layer, a CLI, token scoping, deep links and publishing. Nothing documents a built-in AI assistant users can delegate tasks to, and the shutdown notice further removes the API, Connect and CLI services.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
